title: A back-in-stock alert
caption: Illustrative WhatsApp example from the fictional store Luma: a restocked product and an inert action to review its details. It does not represent a message generated, sent, or received by a real customer.

panels.label: Back in stock
panels.context: A product is available again; the example does not imply reserved stock or an explicit restock request.

messages.text: The mauve Crocs Classic Clog is available again. Check the product details and current stock before you buy.
